about: Edit list for the founder's screen recordings (launch/RECORDING-RUNBOOK.md): owner (rec/owner1.mp4: Claude.ai with PayBox, the real Ridge Roast opening), buyer (rec/buyer.mp4: a fresh Claude.ai chat on the same PayBox account, which knows nothing about the shop: awning_find, awning_buy, the PayBox panel for 5.00 USDC, the confirmation) and owner2 (rec/owner-2.mp4: Claude, P5 and P6). All times are seconds in that recording; every rect is [x, y, width, height] as fractions of the recording frame (0-1). A beat plays its segments in order at normal speed: waits are cut, nothing is sped up. A beat with no segments keeps its placeholder card in the film. 'crop' is the part of the recording the film may show (it cuts the browser's tabs and address bar; the film draws its own window). 'theme' dark draws a dark window to match a dark-mode recording; 'url' is what the film's address bar shows (per beat when the recording switches tabs). 'zoom' keys move the camera: from 'at' it frames 'rect' over 'dur' seconds (0 = a cut on a page change; rect null = the whole page; 'pad' adds air). 'blur' boxes are opaque redactions over anything private (the owner token awn_ot_... wherever it shows), from 'from' to 'to'. 'mark' draws a tomato underline under a line from 'at'. 'focus' dims everything outside a rect (a spotlight; nothing is altered). 'fade' softens the window's left/right edges where the camera crops lines of text. 'type' marks the prompt being typed (paste = it appeared at once). 'approve' rings the PayBox approval at that moment, with a chime. Read times off any player that shows seconds, or run npm run edl-helper -- owner --from 200 --to 240 --every 0.5 --crop 480,100,960,980 for timestamped contact sheets.

p1-type.what: A new chat with PayBox connected; P1 (with the wallet and 'open it with Pro at ridgeroast.shop') pasted at 6.65 s and sent at 14.8 s. The 7 s pause before sending is cut.

plan.what: awning_plan's answer (the PayBox tool permissions and 40 s of loading are cut): the draft with its offers, then the three real domain quotes.

preview.what: The private preview at ridge-roast.awning.sh: caution tape, the canopy rolled up, 'Opening soon'.

p2-approve.what: The PayBox signing panel in the chat: $11.06 to api.awning.sh/x402/open/... 'Sending payment...' turns to 'Payment sent' at 228.07 s (the founder approved in PayBox; the 22 s wait and the reopen request are cut).

live-answer.what: The paid result: 'Ridge Roast is live on Pro. The 11.06 USDC payment went through and settled on Base.', then the Storefront line with https://ridgeroast.shop. The owner token two lines below is redacted.

live-store.what: The storefront, live (ridge-roast.awning.sh while ridgeroast.shop's DNS propagates): canopy down, 'Open for orders in Accra', Buy and Book.

p3-find.what: A fresh Claude.ai chat (same PayBox account; it knows nothing about Ridge Roast). P3 typed and sent; awning_find returns Ridge Roast and the $5 tasting.

p4-buy.what: P4 typed and sent; awning_buy proposes; the PayBox panel shows 5.00 USDC to the owner's sales wallet; approved ('Payment sent'); the confirmation with the order code.

p5-offer.what: P5 typed and sent; awning_add_offer confirms the $30 monthly box.

p6-orders.what: P6 typed and sent; awning_orders lists the 5.00 USDC order, paid, with its transaction. Hold 3 s.
